---
name: Release request
about: Propose a release for the repository owner to review
title: "Release request: "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

## Proposed version and changes

Describe the release and link the relevant pull requests or exact commit.

## Validation

Link CI results and describe any compatibility checks and known limitations.

## Proposed release notes

Include changes, installation impact, and any new requirements.

## Artifact verification

If artifacts have been built, include their filenames, build commit and SHA-256 checksums. Do not include private paths, credentials, targets, or personal reports.

## Owner decision

Submitting this request does not authorize a merge, tag, upload or release. The repository owner must review the exact proposed release and explicitly approve publication. Approval of a code change alone is not release approval; changed commits or artifacts need renewed review.
